matching.label: POST HOC (1): the two sets against AlphaGenome's recorded output-track metadata

classes.matched: MATCHED: the recorded track metadata names this experiment's own ENCODE accession, so the experiment IS one AlphaGenome records as an output track of its own. Accession matching is STRONG: it identifies the experiment, not merely its kind
classes.probable: PROBABLE: the recorded track metadata carries NO accession for any RNA-seq track, so the strong method is unavailable; a track of the SAME biosample (ontology CURIE) and the SAME assay title exists. Biosample+assay matching is SUGGESTIVE ONLY: it establishes that AlphaGenome has an output track of this biosample and assay, hence was trained on SOME ENCODE RNA-seq of it, but NOT that this experiment is the one behind that track
classes.unknown: UNKNOWN: no basis in the record to decide. The metadata has no accession to match and no RNA-seq track of this biosample under this assay. THIS IS NOT 'NOT A TRAINING TRACK': it is the absence of a basis, and it must never be read, reported or summarised as evidence of independence

matching.training_set_record: AlphaGenome's training-set composition is NOT documented at track level in anything this project holds. What IS knowable from the record is which OUTPUT tracks the model carries metadata for, by assay title and biosample ontology CURIE, and that the only ENCODE accessions the metadata names at all are the six PRO-cap track names (ENCSR072YCM, ENCSR182QNJ, ENCSR740IPL, ENCSR797DEF, ENCSR801ECP, ENCSR860TYZ) -- none of them RNA-seq. An output track is a training TARGET, so a biosample+assay match says the model saw some ENCODE RNA-seq of that biosample and assay; it does not say which experiment. This lane therefore reports 'unknown' for the experiment-level question and does NOT infer a training set from a publication's prose.

matching.sentence_for_every_m2i_better: fresh to this project; its independence from AlphaGenome's training data is unknown for 13 of 13 -- AlphaGenome's recorded track metadata carries no ENCODE accession for any RNA-seq track, and a track of the same biosample and assay exists for 13 of 13, which is suggestive of training exposure and settles nothing either way

eleven_cell_subset.label: POST HOC (2): the eleven-cell subset
eleven_cell_subset.note: POST HOC: M2i's comparison recomputed on eleven of the thirteen cells, dropping cardiac muscle cell and hepatocyte -- the two whose biosamples (ENCBS077RUJ, ENCBS343AKO, ENCBS520VFV, ENCBS806KLM) an already-read experiment also used, which is the one non-independence M2i itself disclosed (`non_overlap.cells_sharing_a_read_biosample`). It isolates that disclosed overlap and NOTHING ELSE: it is not a test of independence from AlphaGenome's training data, which the record cannot settle. Everything about it is post hoc. NOTHING IS FITTED: the scale is M2i's constant, D' is recentred within each gene across the eleven kept cells exactly as M2i's own nine-polyA-plus subset recentres, and the interval is M2i's gene-level percentile bootstrap at its registered resamples, seed and percentiles.
eleven_cell_subset.nothing_is_fitted: NOTHING IS FITTED IN THIS LANE. There is no free parameter of any kind: no scale, no intercept, no per-gene and no per-cell parameter, no threshold, no weighting and no transformation is estimated from the fresh RNA or from anything else. The single number the comparison needs, the scale, is the constant SCALE taken from `ac5580b` (SCALE_ORIGIN). The code REFUSES TO FIT: `fit_scale` raises NoFitError when called, and the run calls it nowhere, so a fit cannot be introduced by accident and cannot be introduced quietly. Because nothing is fitted, no training/held-out split is needed to protect the fresh measurement: no fresh value enters any estimate, so every gene of the population is out of sample by construction. The split is nevertheless used to DEFINE the primary population (POPULATION), for the one reason that M2h's +0.04339 was read on its held-out genes and the primary reading here must be the same genes, so the two numbers are comparable
eleven_cell_subset.interval_method: M2i's gene-level percentile bootstrap: 2000 resamples, seed 20261010, percentiles [0.8333333333333334, 99.16666666666667], the scale held fixed

thirteen_cells.label: M2i's thirteen cells, recomputed here for comparison

eleven_cells.label: POST HOC: the eleven cells, cardiac muscle cell and hepatocyte dropped

eleven_cell_subset.reading: POST HOC and deciding nothing. With the two cells whose biosamples an already-read experiment also used dropped, Delta MSE is +0.04596 [98.33% CI +0.04027, +0.05210] on 8,328 genes and 91,608 pairs, against +0.03727 on all thirteen. This isolates the one non-independence M2i disclosed and nothing else; it does not revise M2i's reading and it says nothing about independence from AlphaGenome's training data, which the record cannot settle.

entry_script.why: argv[0] is a file inside this repository that git tracks and reports unmodified: the commit holds the code that wrote the bytes, so a rebuild can run it. The only clean form
entry_script.forms_are_decided_in_advance: genomeos.manifest.ENTRY_FORMS: one clean form (a tracked, unmodified file inside this repository), every other form refuses, and a form that cannot be classified is 'unknown' and refuses too. Read from sys.argv[0] at write time, never declared

code_cleanliness.counting_path_is_computed: the transitive import closure of this script, computed from the files' import statements at write time (genomeos.manifest.counting_path), never by importing: it follows every import that resolves to a file in this repository rather than only the package, counts the __init__.py of each package above a module, resolves bare imports against the directories the source literally puts on sys.path as well as the repository root, and matches every path component against what its directory lists, so a class name such as genomeos.genome.Genome cannot enter it as a file; not a hand-written list
code_cleanliness.note: several lanes work in this one checkout. A file under foreign_uncommitted_code belongs to another lane; this lane did not write it and did not commit it. The counting path is the computed closure above, so a foreign file outside it cannot have entered a number here, and foreign_uncommitted_code_on_the_counting_path names any that could

revision_stamps.sampled: code_cleanliness.git_sha is read while the writer computes; code.git_sha is read when the result is written. Both are HEAD of the same checkout at two moments
revision_stamps.reading: no revision race: both stamps record 18de375

traced_inputs.note: Every file this writer opened for reading under data/ was recorded by an audit hook on the "open" event, canonicalised through data/'s links so one file has one spelling, and compared against the inputs the manifest declares; a member of a declared group counts as declared and hashed on its own, a file under a declared directory counts as declared by prefix. The hook is per interpreter, so a file read by a subprocess is not in this record, nor is one reached through a path that canonicalises to neither this checkout's data/ nor one of its link targets.
